_meta.purpose: Machine-readable known-gap dates for Pipeline/validate.py to check against, replacing the prose-only gap list in ROADMAP.md. A date missing from a dataset but NOT in this file is flagged as a new/unexplained gap.
_meta.how_to_regenerate: Re-run the missing-date scan in this file's generating script against the current CSVs; new entries should get a real, individually-verified reason, not a copy-pasted generic one.
